settings.notice: Made to order · 2–3 days · Delivery across Pakistan
settings.tagline: Sea-inspired jewellery and coastal treasures, gathered from the shores of Gwadar.
settings.closing_line: Picked up at low tide, sent out by post.
settings.story_1: The shells, the sea glass, the worn-smooth pieces that wash up along the Gwadar coast — they are collected by hand, sorted, and strung one at a time. No two pieces come out identical, because no two shells are.
settings.story_2: If you want something in a particular colour, or a length that fits you properly, say so in the message. Most pieces can be made your way.
